notes: DiscoFlate v3.87.0 — 👁 Hide cam. A one-click toggle on the Chat tab that blanks the CAMERA IMAGE while the overlays keep playing, so you can lay out and rehearse a scene live without the room in shot — no tape over the webcam. The frame is blacked out BEFORE anything is composited, so what you see is the real on-air picture minus the camera, not an approximation. The compositor already worked this way (Go Live's intro uses it); it simply had no button. The toggle reflects the server, so it survives a panel reload, and it is kept distinct from the automatic blackout that applies whenever you are off air.
